propositions: Gerrit Verify currently runs thousands of Pandoc subprocess conversions over the complete DC wiki corpus, consuming at least 184.32 seconds of critical path on macOS
ADR 0095 currently mandates that every conversion assertion use the real Pandoc binary, preventing test-boundary optimization

The proposed ADR 0096 narrowly supersedes ADR 0095 only on the testing-assurance clause, moving complete real-Pandoc corpus replay to a dedicated external-integration job while preserving production renderer invariants and compact live probes in Gerrit Verify
The external-integration.yml workflow is currently Ubuntu-only and requires a new pandoc-corpus-replay matrix job with both ubuntu-latest and macos-latest runners
Implementation must obtain paired A/B evidence of actual performance gains and detect version drift and platform-specific binary fingerprints
